title: Gerty MacDowell might easily have held her own beside any lady
html_source:
The theme for George Bernard Shaw’s Pygmalion (1913) and then Lerner and Loewe’s My Fair Lady (1956).

In fact Gerty accomplishes ‘social standing’ momentarily when the viceregal coach passes close to her in Wandering Rocks (Benstock, B. Narrative Con/Texts in Ulysses, p166).
